mutations.name: pan speed read in layout units, not frame widths
kills: camera-path velocity passes a one-second move across one frame width

mutations.name: jerk read as acceleration
mutations.find: const j = a.slice(1).map((ai, i) => sub(ai, a[i]!, hz));
kills: camera-path jerk flags the hard start of a linear move, which the eased move hides

mutations.name: key boxes may sit in the caption strip
kills: camera-path key boxes flags a key box that sits in the caption strip

mutations.name: a reveal is checked only at its beat's start
kills: camera-path reveals flags a reveal the camera holds whole in frame before its cue

mutations.name: the camera-path rows are not registered at L0
kills: camera-path rows at L0 reports all four rows for a run with a camera track
